summary: Improve SLO design, OpenTelemetry planning, and incident response for data and AI services. Explore the five-day intermediate course.
lede: Data and AI platform reliability engineering focuses on keeping production data services and AI workloads dependable. For platform engineers, SREs, and data operations leads, it offers practical ways to diagnose degradation and shape reliability controls. Participants learn to map service dependencies and define SLIs and SLOs, interpret OpenTelemetry signals, and plan incident response and service improvements, including for AI inference.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals responsible for the reliability, observability, and operational support of production data and AI services.
modules: Reliability Boundaries for Data and AI Services
SLI and SLO Design for Platform Workloads
OpenTelemetry Signal Design and Trace Context
Incident Reviews for Data and AI Failures
AI Inference Reliability and Model Serving
prerequisites: This intermediate course suits you if you have working familiarity with data platforms, AI services, or production operations. You should be comfortable discussing service incidents and basic operational metrics. Coding is not required; exercises focus on reliability analysis, service design, and operational decisions.
